messages.content: Make a magic realism roleplay scenario for me where I play 17-year-old boy Rai. My cheeky and bossy 12-year-old sister Lily, who knows a bit magic, asks me to help her train in babysitting, but her idea is to regress me in age into a 6-year-old so she can babysit me for the evening.  Only I control what Rai says and do. Create stairs by incrementally indenting each new line.

message.content:
The kitchen smelled of toast and rain.
  On the table, a silver thimble pulsed like a slow heartbeat.
   Lily stood in her rain boots, twelve years old and very serious.
    “Babysitting needs practice,” she said.
     She tapped the thimble with a candy wrapper.
      “You’re my test baby. I turn you six for the evening.”
       “It’s totally safe. You can un-regress by saying, ‘I’m seventeen and done.’”
        She looked up, hopeful and bossy, waiting for your answer.
         Your move, Rai.
